Summarize a TWFE decomposition

Source: R/twfeweights_mp.R
summary.decomposed_twfe.Rd

Prints the TWFE coefficient and its decomposition from implicit_twfe_weights(), and returns either the \((g,t)\)-level decomposition or, after twfe_cov_bal(), a covariate balance table.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'decomposed_twfe'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A decomposed_twfe object.

...

Not used.

Value

A data.frame. Before twfe_cov_bal(): one row per \((g,t)\) cell with group, time.period, post, twfe_att_gt (the weighted comparison) and alpha_weight. After: one row per covariate with unweighted and weighted means for the treated and comparison groups, their differences and the other balance statistics, averaged over post-treatment cells using the TWFE weights.

Details

The printed lines are: the TWFE coefficient (alpha twfe); the decomposition without remainder terms (alpha decomp); the part from post-treatment comparisons only (alpha post only); the contribution of pre-treatment comparisons (pta violations bias); the remainder terms; and an effective sample size for the comparison group that combines the per-cell effective sample sizes across post-treatment cells.

Examples

data(castle, package = "causaldata")
castle <- as.data.frame(castle)
castle$G <- BMisc::get_group(castle, "sid", tname = "year", treatname = "post")
tw <- implicit_twfe_weights(
  yname = "l_homicide", tname = "year", idname = "sid", gname = "G",
  xformula = ~l_police, base_period = "gmin1", data = castle
)
